description:
In an unprecedented maneuver, the Starship spacecraft came sweeping down to a pinpoint landing within the arms of SpaceX’s Mechazilla launch tower.

This marks the first time in the history of rocketry that the upper stage of a rocket has returned home from orbit to a safe, upright landing — potentially paving the way for it to be used again.

SpaceX attempted to guide the Super Heavy rocket booster back to a pinpoint landing at its South Texas launch tower, called Mechazilla, but the maneuver was ultimately unsuccessful. The company redirected the booster to splash down in the Gulf.

Maryland Senator Chris Van Hollen has announced a surprise bid to challenge Chuck Schumer for Senate Democratic Majority Leader. While Schumer is widely viewed as the frontrunner following Democrats’ sweeping midterm victories, Van Hollen’s campaign reflects a growing desire within the caucus for a fresh direction.

CNN’s Lauren Fox breaks down the dynamics of the upcoming secret-ballot vote, the debate over key legislative priorities like the filibuster and affordability, and how Democrats are approaching oversight.
